description: x402 Listing Check: Seller-side pre-listing check: will a default x402 client be able to pay this endpoint? Validates any 402 — accepts[] completeness (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), placeholder scan of the published input example, challenge size vs the 8190 B edge limit. Required input: url = absolute http(s) URL of the endpoint to check. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE, each with a fix. Use before listing an API, or when a buyer says your endpoint does not work.
name: x402-listing-check
